sdk.errorMessage: SmartCon is pinned to the .NET 8 SDK (8.0.4xx). Reason: every .NET 10 SDK build of this solution is 10-20x slower (dotnet/roslyn#81704 — tiered compilation is disabled in the SDK 10 compiler, and the 10.0.300+ fix does not restore the speed: 98-115 s cold vs 6-19 s on SDK 8). Revit 2027 (net10) is disabled via SmartConEnableRevit2027=false in src/Directory.Build.props. To bring Revit 2027 back: install the 10.0.4xx SDK, flip that flag to true and pin this file back to the 10.0.4xx band. Install .NET 8 SDK from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0
